import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Filter out rows with missing values in the relevant columns
df_filtered = df.dropna(subset=["Sex of respondent, 1979", "Highest grade completed, 1979"])

# Convert the gender column to a categorical variable
df_filtered["Sex of respondent, 1979"] = df_filtered["Sex of respondent, 1979"].astype(int)

# Create a boxplot to visualize the relationship between gender and degree completion rates
sns.boxplot(x="Sex of respondent, 1979", y="Highest grade completed, 1979", data=df_filtered)
plt.xlabel("Gender")
plt.ylabel("Highest Grade Completed")
plt.title("Relationship between Gender and Degree Completion Rates")
plt.show()
